answer: Surprise liveness rounds expose puppet agents. At random moments the network sends every identity a fresh, hard task at the same instant, with a short deadline. An honest agent just answers. A Sybil operator who hides a hundred names behind one hollow server must now run a hundred full copies at once, or watch most names miss the window and lose rank. Like a raven checking every nest at dawn, the test can drop anywhere, so the anchor of each identity is real, always-on compute that the attacker pays for per fake.
